orchestration.policy: Free, local, open-source, and already-installed tools only. iart-ai motion packs are MIT/open-source and installed only when approved. Remotion, motionmaxxing and Open 3D are normal locally executed specialists; Hairline, img2threejs and the Opus prompt catalog retain their optional gates. motionmaxxing must not call ElevenLabs or any paid voice/music API. img2threejs must use only local generic/character profiles and never call Tripo, Hyper3D, CharacterGen, or paid plugins. QA uses Agent Desktop for native UI verification and local browser/render tools for measurements; BrowserCode is only an explicitly requested optional preview target, with no paid BrowserPod keys. No paid APIs, metered SaaS, premium models, subscriptions, trials, billing, cloud rendering, publishing, scheduling, generation providers, or credits. The visual-style-agent uses only local procedural/CSS/SVG/Canvas/Three.js/WebGL/FFmpeg techniques and user-provided assets. UI/UX Pro Max uses only its MIT local data/search scripts and open/local assets; no paid design APIs or hosted services.

hairline-agent.use_when: The brief requests an interactive line figure, pointer-responsive diagram, technical illustration, or self-contained Hairline visual.
hairline-agent.default_recommendation: skip unless the interaction requires it.

opus5-videos-agent.use_when: The brief explicitly wants a starting prompt from the Opus 5.5 code-authored video catalog.
opus5-videos-agent.default_recommendation: skip. It researches prompts only and does not render.

ui-ux-pro-max-agent.use_when: The brief includes UI, landing pages, dashboards, product demos, forms, navigation, charts, mobile UI, or UX/accessibility review.
ui-ux-pro-max-agent.default_recommendation: skip for pure non-UI films; recommend for any interface or interaction proof.

img2threejs-agent.use_when: The brief supplies a 2D reference image of an object, product, prop, or character and requires a procedural code-only Three.js THREE.Group reconstruction.
img2threejs-agent.default_recommendation: skip unless a reference photo must be reconstructed into a procedural 3D model.
